name: whisper-models
licenseNote: OpenAI Whisper weights (Copyright (c) 2022 OpenAI, MIT, https://github.com/openai/whisper), converted to the ggml format by the whisper.cpp authors (MIT, https://huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp). The weights never ride a release archive: the product downloads one model on first use into <config-home>/models/whisper, verified against the sha256 below before the rename into place.

models.name: tiny.en-q5_1
models.words: Whisper tiny.en, English, 5-bit weights — the smallest and fastest, less accurate

models.name: small.en-q5_1
models.words: Whisper small.en, English, 5-bit weights — more accurate, three times the size

models.name: base-q5_1
models.words: Whisper base, multilingual, 5-bit weights — for speech that is not English

notes: Pinned 2026-09-06 from the whisper.cpp model repository's resolve URLs; the upstream README publishes SHA-1 digests only, so every sha256 was taken once from the downloaded bytes and is re-verified on every later fetch (a moved or changed file fails the digest loudly, never silently). The default is base.en-q5_1 (English only — the English-only models are more accurate than the multilingual ones at this size); the multilingual row is for speech in another language, chosen through MERCURY_WHISPER_MODEL. The catalogue in the product is compiled from this file (src/services/voice/whisperModels.ts); `bun run scripts/vendor/fetch-whisper-models.ts` fetches the provers' copies into vendor/whisper-models/ (untracked). Update procedure: change a row's file and url, download it, record its byte count and sha256 here, run the fetch, and re-run `bash scripts/voice/run-all.sh`.
